properties.name: value
properties.comment: The shown date and time (Value), within minimum and maximum; an invalid or out-of-range value throws std::out_of_range. A change raises value_changed.
prepare: throw std::out_of_range("DateTimePicker value is invalid or outside its range");

properties.name: minimum
properties.comment: The earliest value (MinDate). A minimum after maximum moves maximum to it; value is then clamped into the range (raising value_changed) and an open calendar closes. An invalid date throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare validates; written applies the crossing rule, clamps value through its cell and closes the calendar

properties.name: maximum
properties.comment: The latest value (MaxDate). A maximum before minimum moves minimum to it; value is then clamped into the range (raising value_changed) and an open calendar closes. An invalid date throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare validates; written applies the crossing rule, clamps value through its cell and closes the calendar

properties.name: format
properties.comment: Which of the format provider's patterns shows the value, or custom_format (Format). An undeclared format throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: custom_format
properties.comment: The pattern used when format is custom (CustomFormat). Invalid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare validates UTF-8; written invalidates only while format is custom

properties.name: format_provider
properties.comment: The month and day names and the patterns the value is shown with. An invalid provider throws std::invalid_argument; a change closes an open calendar.
hand: prepare validates the provider; written closes the calendar and invalidates

properties.name: show_check_box
properties.comment: Whether a check box before the value lets the user mark it as not set (ShowCheckBox).

properties.name: checked
properties.comment: Whether the value is set, shown by the check box (Checked). A change raises checked_changed (Windows Forms raises ValueChanged).

properties.name: show_up_down
properties.comment: Whether arrows replace the calendar button (ShowUpDown); turning them on closes an open calendar.
hand: written closes the calendar when the arrows turn on

properties.name: dropped_down
properties.comment: Whether the calendar is open; a view, since the calendar closes itself on commit, cancel and dismissal. A write opens or closes it and raises drop_down_changed.
hand: a view onto dropped_down_, which the overlay's callbacks move; write_view opens or closes the calendar

properties.name: drop_down_alignment
properties.comment: Which edge the calendar aligns to (DropDownAlign). An undeclared alignment throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("DateTimePicker drop-down alignment is invalid");

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The value's font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("DateTimePicker font specification is invalid");

properties.name: style
properties.comment: The field's colours; a view, since the theme's colours apply until it is written. A write's text colour then inks the value.
hand: a view onto style_ beside style_authored_; write_view marks the style authored and repaints the background

not_properties.name: set_range
not_properties.reason: writes minimum and maximum together; kept as a method over the two cells
